verify.body: Meet in person: one of you taps "Scan their code" and scans the other's screen. Or compare the 60 digits together; if they match, nobody is in between.

verify.mismatchBody: Make sure you scanned the right person's code. If it still doesn't match, don't share your location with them.
verify.checking: Getting the keys from the server again and checking…
verify.notCode: This is not a safety code
verify.notCodeBody: {{name}} should open the Safety number screen with you on their phone and show the code there.
verify.theirsDiffer: The key the server gives for {{name}} is not the one on their phone. Someone may be in between: don't share your location with this person.
verify.mineDiffer: {{name}}'s phone sees a different key for you; most likely it has not caught up yet. {{name}} should close this screen on their phone and open it again, then scan again. If it still fails, don't share your location.
verify.otherPair: This code is for someone else
verify.otherPairBody: This code is not between {{name}} and you. {{name}} should open the screen with you on their phone.
verify.offlineBody: The keys could not be fetched from the server. Scan again once connected; until you have verified, don't share your location with this person.
verify.noDeviceBody: {{name}} is not signed in on any phone right now. Scan again once they sign in; until you have verified, don't share your location with this person.

permission.title: Share your location with your circles
permission.body: Bargu uses your location so the people you choose can see you on the map. While sharing is on, it continues when the app is closed or the screen is locked, and a "Sharing your location" notification stays in your notification bar. Your location is encrypted on your phone; not even Bargu's server can see it. You can stop at any time with ghost mode or by turning a circle off. Your location is never used for ads or anything else.

notice.title: Privacy notice
notice.lead: Before using Bargu, read briefly how your data is processed.
notice.what: Your email (to sign in, as a hash), your username and avatar, your location, optionally your profile photo and location history, your device keys and security events.
notice.why: To provide the service you ask for: sharing your location with the people you choose (performance of the contract). Location history is optional and asks for your explicit consent separately.
notice.encryptedTitle: The server cannot see your location
notice.encrypted: Your location, places, photo and history are encrypted on your phone. No ads; we do not sell your data.
notice.shared: Only the circles you choose. Our providers (hosting, notifications, email) cannot read the encrypted content.
notice.rights: Download your data, delete your account in the app or on the web page, and ask for information (KVKK Art. 11).

consent.title: Explicit consent to location history
consent.review: Location history is on in one of your circles. Under new rules we ask for separate explicit consent; without it, history is turned off and deleted.
consent.what: In circles you turn it on for, while you share your exact location, your phone writes quarter-hour trails and sends them encrypted.
consent.who: Only that circle's members, from when they joined. Our server cannot open the trails.
consent.howLong: At most 14 days; then it is deleted by itself.
consent.withdraw: Any time: turn history off in the circle, or Me → Privacy and account → Withdraw consent. Withdrawing deletes the copy on the server too.
consent.statement: I give my explicit consent to my location history being processed as described. Giving it is optional; I can use the rest of Bargu without it.
consent.declineReview: I do not consent; turn history off
consent.declinedOff: Your location history was turned off and deleted
consent.offline: No connection; could not check your consent. Try again in a moment.

privacy.title: Privacy and account
privacy.noticeBody: How your data is processed, who receives it, and your rights.
privacy.consentNone: You have not consented to location history. It is asked when you turn history on in a circle.
privacy.withdrawBody: Location history turns off in every circle and the copy on the server is deleted.
privacy.withdrawn: Consent withdrawn; history turned off and deleted
privacy.exportBody: Saves a copy of your account, devices, circles, security events and the data this phone can open (your own location history, places, event plans) as a JSON file in a folder you pick. The file includes your location history; keep it somewhere safe.
privacy.deleteHint: Your account becomes unusable at once, you leave your circles and this phone is signed out; your account and data are deleted for good within minutes, at most 7 days. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteBody: You leave your circles; in a group you run, the longest-standing member becomes admin, and your friendships end. Places you added to circles stay there; delete them first if you like. You may want to download your data first.
privacy.deleteSureBody: Your account and all your data will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
privacy.findable: People can find me by username
privacy.findableHint: When off, nobody can find or add you by username; only people you give your QR code or invite link to can add you.

age.title: How old are you?
age.lead: Bargu is for 15 and older; privacy is stricter for 15–17. We do not ask for your birth date. Only your age band is kept, and nobody else sees it.
age.teenHint: Nobody can find you by your username, your location history stays off, your location starts off in a new circle, and you join events only with a friend’s QR code.
age.tooYoungBody: You cannot use Bargu before you are 15; this is a legal limit. No account was opened and nothing about you was sent. If you chose by mistake, go back and fix it.
age.checkLead: New rules ask us to learn every account’s age band once. We do not ask for your birth date; only your age band is kept, and nobody else sees it.
age.under15Body: People under 15 cannot use Bargu. Your account and all your data will be deleted; this cannot be undone.
age.current: Your age band: {{band}}. Nobody else can see it.
age.unknown: You have not said your age band yet.
age.toTeenBody: Nobody will find you by your username, your location history is turned off and deleted, and your location starts off in new circles. Going back to 18 or older needs you to write to us.
age.toAdultHint: If you have turned 18 or chose by mistake, write to the address in the privacy notice; a person will look at it.

guardians.title: Parent link
guardians.childIntro: If you like, you can add one or two parents. A parent sees your age band, since when you are linked, and the people in your circles (who could see your location). They do not see your location, history, places or status. Nothing is hidden: you see what they see on the same screen.

upgrade.where: You'll find the new version at the download link you were sent, or in the app store.
